speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your appointment. I see you are a newborn presenting with a generalized rash; to understand what you are dealing with, I need to ask a few questions. Can you tell me exactly how long this rash has been present and what it looks like?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Gonococcal Infection (Neisseria gonorrhoeae).

I am requesting images of the rash and the eyes to confirm the presence of pustular lesions and ophthalmia neonatorum. REQUEST IMAGES: Skin_rash_and_eyes
